Smile makeover: transforming confidence through dentistry

What a smile makeover actually involves, which treatments it combines, and how to judge whether the result will look like you.

In 2026, Istanbul remains the world’s leading destination for dental tourism. However, the secret to a successful, life-long result isn’t just finding a clinic—it’s navigating the market with expert precision. At Vea Health, we’ve redefined the journey, moving beyond simple bookings to independent, elite medical coordination.

The most common mistake international patients make is choosing a “general clinic” based solely on price. For complex procedures like Oral Surgery and Implantology, the skill of the surgeon is the primary factor in long-term success.

At Vea Health, we exclusively partner with the top 1% of board-certified dental surgeons in Istanbul. These specialists don’t just place implants; they perform Surgical Rehab and ensure proper Bone Support using advanced Membrane techniques to guarantee stability and health.

For patients suffering from extensive tooth loss, 2026 technology offers incredible solutions. We specialize in coordinating:

All-on-4 & All-on-6 Systems: Providing a full set of teeth on just four or six titanium implants.

Hybrid Prosthesis: A revolutionary blend of strength and aesthetics, available in both Porcelain and Zirconium.

Temporary Prosthesis: Ensuring you never leave the clinic without a smile, even during the healing phase immediately after surgery.

A transformation isn’t just about function; it’s about the “Hollywood Smile.” Depending on your needs, our partners utilize:

Monolithic Zirconium: For maximum durability and back-teeth strength.

E-Max & Lumineers: For that ultra-natural, translucent front-teeth aesthetic that mimics real enamel perfectly.

Independent Quality Assurance: We don’t work for the clinic; we work for you. We rigorously vet every protocol.

VIP Hospitality: Your journey is seamless, featuring private VIP transfers and luxury 5-star accommodations.

Transparent All-Inclusive Packages: No hidden fees. We provide a clear, upfront quote that covers your entire medical and travel logistics.

Yes, provided you work with board-certified specialists. Vea Health’s independent oversight ensures that international safety and sterilization standards are strictly followed.

While prices vary based on the system (All-on-4 vs. All-on-6), Turkey remains 60-70% more affordable than the UK or USA, without compromising on premium materials like Straumann or Nobel Biocare.

With our advanced surgical techniques, most patients return to their normal routine within a few days, with the final permanent prosthesis being fitted after 3 to 6 months of osseointegration.

Don’t leave your smile to chance. In the crowded landscape of Istanbul dental clinics, Vea Health stands as your beacon of quality, transparency, and elite care.

This article is general information and is not a diagnosis or a treatment plan. Whether a treatment suits you can only be determined by a clinician who has examined you.
